title: A signal after a meal
hook: Connect a hormonal signal with a target.

knows: Hormones can carry signals through the blood to target tissues.
doesNotKnow: Insulin released by pancreatic beta cells can increase glucose uptake in skeletal muscle and adipose tissue and helps reduce blood glucose.

misconception: All hormones come from one gland and act on every cell.
objective: Identify the stated endocrine signal and its target in a simplified pathway.

claims.text: Question, diagram and explanation: Which hormone from pancreatic beta cells can increase glucose uptake in skeletal muscle and adipose tissue? Insulin released by pancreatic beta cells can increase glucose uptake in skeletal muscle and adipose tissue and helps reduce blood glucose.
The diagram shows one selected source–target pathway, not all hormone effects or feedback loops.

Recall: In the stated example, which source releases Insulin into the circulation? Insulin released by pancreatic beta cells can increase glucose uptake in skeletal muscle and adipose tissue and helps reduce blood glucose.
